city_scope_filter.boundary_source_name: OSNI Open Data - Largescale Boundaries - Local Government Districts (2012)
city_scope_filter.boundary_licence: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) v3.0; contains Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland data.
city_scope_filter.boundary_scope: Belfast Local Government District 2012 boundary, delineated under the Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 2012 and used from the 2014 elections.
city_scope_filter.method: Retains current OSM major-road features only where they intersect the official city boundary polygon, then splits or truncates line geometry at the boundary using source vertices and approximate crossing points. The boundary scopes the visual context; OSM remains the road-geometry source.

metadata.method: Current OSM road geometry is loaded as a base layer after official city-boundary scope filtering; selected-year activity files color the subset near source-backed transport records.
metadata.caveat: Base road lines are citywide OSM context and are not measured traffic counts, live congestion, or historical construction proof.
